rules: Pick ONE set per reel at the storyboard stage and lock it (scripts/lock_cast.py). Every frame of that reel uses the locked looks.
Poses change freely within a reel; looks never do — except one scripted transformation beat (e.g. Rick puts the VR visor on at the reveal), declared in the lock as 'transform'.
Rotate sets between reels: lock_cast.py skips sets used in the last 3 reels unless the user asks for one.
New transformations from the series need art first: add them to art_needed, never fake them with overlays that change the character's body.
